Fix derive middleware setting 400 on static file responses
────────────────────────────────────────
ULID:      01KK5WX0TMYDP3NV9VFEE9HHDT
Type:      task
Status:    needs_work
Priority:  1
Automation: eligible

─── Description ───
  The derive middleware in packages/daemon/src/middleware/project-context.ts runs on every request including static files. When no .kspec/ project is registered, it sets status 400 on all responses, breaking dynamic ES module imports in the web UI. Fix: skip project context resolution for non-API routes and /api/health. Also add / to SPA fallback routes. See GitHub issue #689.
Tags:      bug, daemon, web-ui
Created:   2026-03-08T04:57:14.835Z
Started:   2026-03-08T09:01:21.344Z

─── Notes ───
[2026-03-08T09:02:43.456Z] @claude:
Fix applied in two files:
1. packages/daemon/src/middleware/project-context.ts — Added early return in derive middleware to skip project context resolution for non-API routes and /api/health. Non-API routes (static files, SPA pages) get projectContext: undefined instead of triggering a 400 when no project is configured.
2. packages/daemon/src/server.ts — Added '/' to spaRoutes array so the root path correctly serves index.html via SPA fallback.
All daemon unit tests pass (53 tests). TypeScript compiles clean.
[2026-03-08T09:18:07.300Z] Jacob Chapel:
[FIX_CYCLE: 1] Review findings: MUST-FIX: add regression coverage for non-API/static requests, /api/health, and root SPA fallback before merge (see PR #707 review).
